name: agent-shuriken
description: Careful plugins for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: account-cleanup
plugins.description: Find web accounts you no longer use without reading any passwords, then cancel subscriptions and delete the accounts you approve

plugins.name: compare-report
plugins.description: Research the candidates for a choice and write an HTML and PDF comparison report, with a source for every claim and a rationale for every score

plugins.name: diagram-explainer
plugins.description: Write an explainer as one HTML file with a figure drawn in every section, built from JSON and checked before you share it

plugins.name: pc-tidy
plugins.description: List what has gone unused on your Mac and delete only the items you pick to free up disk space

plugins.name: root-cause
plugins.description: Find the cause of a bug from evidence before fixing it, then fix only the cause with a test that fails first

plugins.name: secure-dotfile
plugins.description: Find API keys and tokens written into your shell startup files and move the ones you pick into the macOS Keychain, without the agent seeing any value

plugins.name: techdebt
plugins.description: Rank the files most worth fixing by combining how often they change with their size, old TODO comments, missing tests, long functions, and duplication, without downloading anything
